name: eng
description: Plan-to-ship engineering pipeline. Six composable skills (scope, grill, eng-review, tdd, execute, ship) plus an orchestrator (eng-flow), each a single pass over a shared markdown doc in the project's .plan folder, with full and express tracks. Standalone skills: conventions (house-style cache every other skill reads), understand, debug, spike, adr, refactor, backfill-tests, pr-walkthrough, pr-review, review.
